name: salesforce
description: Query, create, and update records in your org.

salesforce_mcp_url.title: Salesforce MCP server URL
salesforce_mcp_url.description: Server URL from Setup → MCP Servers. Production: https://api.salesforce.com/platform/mcp/v1/platform/sobject-all. Sandbox or scratch: https://api.salesforce.com/platform/mcp/v1/sandbox/platform/sobject-all. For custom servers, replace platform/ with custom/.

client_id.title: Salesforce Consumer Key
client_id.description: Consumer Key of the External Client App you created for this integration (Setup → External Client App Manager → your app → Settings → Consumer Key and Secret).
